variables.name: ECID
variables.description: Adobe Experience Cloud ID; primary visitor identifier auto-collected by AEP Web SDK.

variables.name: Business Unit
variables.description: Mandatory baseline dimension identifying the business unit / property for cross-report filtering.

variables.name: Device Type
variables.description: Device type auto-derived from user agent by AEP Web SDK. Supports responsive/mobile-first reporting.

variables.name: Campaign Tracking Code
variables.description: Native campaign tracking code sourced from the campaign query parameter on the landing URL.

variables.name: Campaign Source
variables.description: SAINT classification of the campaign tracking code into source.

variables.name: Environment
variables.description: Environment flag used by the Production Data Only segment to exclude dev/stage traffic.

variables.name: Login / Registration Status
variables.description: Visitor registration/login status (email-verified). Supports registration KPIs and personalisation gating.

variables.name: Visitor ID (Hashed)
variables.description: [Hashed — PII] SHA-256 hashed visitor ID for profile stitching to AEP/RT-CDP. Hashing performed in JS before data-layer entry.

variables.name: Student Cohort Flag
variables.description: Derived student cohort flag (geo cluster + visit timing + referral). Not stored as permanent PII; refreshed annually.

variables.name: Page Name
variables.description: Human-readable page name for content reporting across all instrumented pages.

variables.name: Site Section
variables.description: Top-level site section for content grouping (e.g. Programme, Trails, Map, Privacy).

variables.name: Page Type
variables.description: Page template/type (listing, detail, privacy, terms, cookie-policy) for content classification.

variables.name: Government Disclaimer Present
variables.description: Flag capturing presence of the standard government disclaimer on the page.

variables.name: Brand Compliance Flag
variables.description: Flag indicating page conformance with Heritage SG brand guidelines.

variables.name: Programme / Installation ID
variables.description: Unique ID of the festival programme or installation being viewed.

variables.name: Programme / Installation Title
variables.description: Title of the programme or installation for content listing reporting.

variables.name: Venue Name
variables.description: Venue associated with the programme or installation listing.

variables.name: Schema.org Structured Data Type
variables.description: Schema.org JSON-LD type rendered on the page (Event, Place, ImageObject) for SEO structured-data tracking.

variables.name: Unlocked Content Status
variables.description: Whether QR-unlocked content is present/visible on the programme detail page (no empty state when absent).

variables.name: Interaction Name
variables.description: Name of the tracked user interaction event (generic custom-link dimension).

variables.name: Exit Link / CTA Destination
variables.description: Destination of the Klook ticketing CTA and other off-site exit links.

variables.name: Registration Trigger Moment
variables.description: Context/moment that triggered the registration prompt (QR scan, itinerary adoption, profile). Used for funnel-by-trigger reporting.

variables.name: Consent Tier
variables.description: Three-tier consent model value (Tier 0 Functional, Tier 1 Festival Marketing, Tier 2 Year-Round NHB).

variables.name: Consent Action
variables.description: Consent action taken (grant / withdraw) captured for the consent log.

variables.name: Cookie Consent Category
variables.description: Cookie consent category chosen (Strictly Necessary, Analytics & Performance, Personalisation & Targeting).

variables.name: Map Zone Label
variables.description: Client-side derived zone label (never raw GPS) passed for proximity sorting and crowd density. PDPA-compliant per BRD 1802.

variables.name: Location Permission State
variables.description: Whether the visitor granted or denied location permission; governs proximity sorting vs. default listing.

variables.name: Map Interaction Type
variables.description: Type of interaction with the interactive precinct map (pin tap, zoom, sort, directions).

variables.name: Trail Name
variables.description: Name of the curated self-guided trail being viewed, saved or followed.

variables.name: Trail Step / Progress
variables.description: Current trail step or progress state tracked via QR check-ins.

variables.name: Itinerary ID
variables.description: Unique ID of the custom itinerary created, shared, viewed or adopted.

variables.name: Itinerary Share / Adoption Source
variables.description: Source/channel of itinerary native share and one-tap adoption; feeds Community Picks surfacing.

variables.name: Optimisation Suggestion Type
variables.description: Type of inline itinerary optimisation suggestion surfaced (conflict, inefficiency) and whether dismissed.

variables.name: QR Check-in Installation ID
variables.description: Installation ID captured on a QR scan check-in event against the registered visitor's profile. Venue check-in source per BRD 1803.

variables.name: Personalisation Use Case
variables.description: Adobe Target personalisation use case served (e.g. 'Your picks tonight', 'Trending with your circle', returning-visitor banner).

variables.name: Recommendation / Content Rank
variables.description: Rank/position of an affinity-matched recommendation or auto-sorted listing item.

variables.name: Session Loop / Circle Hash
variables.description: [Hashed — PII] SHA-256 session-hash cluster key for 'Trending with your circle' chip. Hashing in JS before data-layer entry.

variables.name: Brand Concierge Query Intent
variables.description: Classified visitor intent of a Brand Concierge query (programme discovery, trail recommendation, venue info, general).

variables.name: Brand Concierge Outcome
variables.description: Outcome of a Brand Concierge interaction (answered, escalated, failed) for engagement/escalation reporting.

variables.name: Page URL
variables.description: Full URL of the page, mirrored from the Page URL eVar to enable PathFinder/next-page-flow pathing analysis.

variables.name: Business Unit
variables.description: Business unit / brand identifier, mirrored from the Business Unit eVar to support ClickMap and pathing segmentation.

variables.name: Page Name
variables.description: Human-readable page name mirrored from the Page Name eVar; enables ClickMap and PathFinder across programme and installation listing pages.

variables.name: Site Section
variables.description: Top-level site section mirrored from the Site Section eVar; supports pathing flow between Programme, Trails, Map and Info sections.

variables.name: Programme Title
variables.description: Programme / installation title mirrored from the Programme Title eVar; enables ClickMap and pathing on individual festival listings.

variables.name: Venue Name
variables.description: Venue / precinct location mirrored from the Venue Name eVar; supports ClickMap on the interactive Bras Basah–Bugis precinct map.

variables.name: Trail Name
variables.description: Self-guided trail name mirrored from the Trail Name eVar; enables pathing across trail selection and navigation flows.

variables.name: Installation ID
variables.description: Installation identifier captured on QR scan, mirrored from the Installation ID eVar; supports pathing and ClickMap on check-in interactions.

variables.name: Registration Trigger Moment
variables.description: Context that triggered the registration prompt, mirrored from the Registration Trigger eVar; enables pathing of the registration funnel by trigger moment.

variables.name: Page Views
variables.description: OOTB page view metric collected automatically on every page load by AEP Web SDK.

variables.name: Custom Page View
variables.description: Custom page view counter fired on every page load to anchor content and engagement reporting.

variables.name: Page Load Time (ms)
variables.description: Numeric page load time in milliseconds; paired with Page Load Time Instances to derive Avg Page Load Time. Supports Core Web Vitals monitoring (BRD 1504).

variables.name: Page Load Time Instances
variables.description: Counter paired with Page Load Time (ms) to compute Avg Page Load Time calculated metric.

variables.name: Programme Listing View
variables.description: Fires when a festival programme or installation listing is displayed (title, description, venue, dates/times). Supports BRD 104.

variables.name: Klook Ticketing CTA Click
variables.description: Fires on click of the Klook ticketing call-to-action directing visitors off-site. Supports BRD 105.

variables.name: Privacy Policy View
variables.description: Fires on Privacy Policy page view documenting PDPA data collection, purpose, retention and rights. Supports BRD 107.

variables.name: Terms of Use View
variables.description: Fires on Terms of Use page view. Supports BRD 108.

variables.name: Cookie Policy View
variables.description: Fires on Cookie Policy page view documenting all cookies, purpose, category and retention. Supports BRD 1812.

variables.name: Registration Start
variables.description: Journey Start event — fires when a visitor begins the email registration flow. Supports BRD 201/1205.

variables.name: Registration Complete
variables.description: Journey Complete event — fires when email registration is verified via one-time code or link. Supports BRD 201/202.

variables.name: Registration Fail
variables.description: Journey Fail event — fires when email verification fails or is abandoned during registration. Supports BRD 201/1205.

variables.name: Consent Granted
variables.description: Fires when a visitor grants a consent tier (Tier 0/1/2) via positive action at registration. Supports BRD 301/302/304.

variables.name: Consent Withdrawn
variables.description: Fires when a visitor withdraws consent via self-service profile settings, effective immediately. Supports BRD 303/304.

variables.name: Cookie Consent Submitted
variables.description: Fires when a visitor submits cookie consent choices via the banner or settings control. Supports BRD 1808/1809/1810/1811.

variables.name: Data Rights Request
variables.description: Fires on self-service view, correction or erasure of personal data requests. Supports BRD 1805.

variables.name: Map Interaction
variables.description: Fires on interaction with the Bras Basah–Bugis precinct map (pan, zoom, pin tap). Supports BRD 401/402.

variables.name: Location Permission Granted
variables.description: Fires when a visitor grants location permission, enabling proximity-based sorting by walking distance. Supports BRD 403.

variables.name: Location Permission Denied
variables.description: Fires when a visitor denies location permission; default listing behaviour applies without degradation. Supports BRD 404.

variables.name: Crowd Density Indicator View
variables.description: Fires when a live per-venue crowd density indicator is displayed, derived from real-time Adobe Analytics session data. Supports BRD 405/406.

variables.name: Trail Saved
variables.description: Fires when a registered visitor saves/follows a curated self-guided trail. Supports BRD 501/502.

variables.name: Itinerary Item Added
variables.description: Fires when a programme or installation is added to a custom itinerary. Supports BRD 503.

variables.name: Itinerary Optimisation Suggestion
variables.description: Fires when a dismissible non-blocking inline optimisation suggestion is surfaced for itinerary conflicts/inefficiencies. Supports BRD 504.

variables.name: Itinerary Shared
variables.description: Fires when an itinerary is shared via native device share (no social OAuth). Supports BRD 505/705.

variables.name: Itinerary Adopted
variables.description: Fires on one-tap adoption of a shared itinerary (triggers light registration prompt). Supports BRD 506/705.

variables.name: Community Pick Surfaced
variables.description: Fires when an itinerary reaching ≥10 unique festival-window adoptions is surfaced as a Community Pick. Supports BRD 507/705.

variables.name: QR Check-in
variables.description: Fires on a QR scan recorded as a confirmed check-in against the registered visitor's profile (installation ID + timestamp). Supports BRD 601/604/1803.

variables.name: Unlocked Content View
variables.description: Fires when unlocked content visible only to physically scanned-in visitors is loaded on the programme detail page. Supports BRD 602/605/1104.

variables.name: Registration Prompt Shown
variables.description: Fires when the dismissible email registration prompt is triggered on first QR scan by an unauthenticated visitor. Supports BRD 603/1205.

variables.name: Picks Tonight Feed View
variables.description: Fires when the 'Your picks tonight' affinity-matched bookmark feed is shown to a registered visitor. Supports BRD 702/706.

variables.name: Trending With Circle Chip View
variables.description: Fires when the 'Trending with your circle' chip is shown using session hash clustering. Supports BRD 703/706.

variables.name: Returning Visitor Banner View
variables.description: Fires when a contextual banner for unvisited bookmarks or incomplete trail stops is shown to a returning visitor. Supports BRD 704/706.

variables.name: Programme Bookmarked
variables.description: Fires when a visitor bookmarks a programme, feeding the 'Your picks tonight' and trending chip logic. Supports BRD 702/703.

variables.name: Brand Concierge Interaction
variables.description: Fires on a Brand Concierge query/interaction, capturing engagement for intent and engagement-rate reporting. Supports BRD 1405/1406.

variables.name: Brand Concierge Escalation
variables.description: Fires when a Brand Concierge interaction results in an escalation or unresolved/failed response, for failure-rate reporting. Supports BRD 1406.

metrics_segments.name: Production Data Only
metrics_segments.description: Restricts reporting to production environment hits where the Environment eVar = 'production'. Excludes dev/stage traffic.

metrics_segments.name: Bounce Rate
metrics_segments.description: OOTB calculated metric: single-hit visits divided by entries. Measures single-page visit share.

metrics_segments.name: Conversion Rate
metrics_segments.description: OOTB calculated metric: success events divided by visits. Baseline conversion measure.

metrics_segments.name: Pages per Visit
metrics_segments.description: OOTB calculated metric: page views divided by visits. Baseline depth-of-engagement measure.

metrics_segments.name: All Visits
metrics_segments.description: Baseline segment capturing all visits with no filter, used as a denominator and reporting default.

metrics_segments.name: New Visitors
metrics_segments.description: Baseline segment isolating first-time visitors via OOTB New/Return Visitor dimension.

metrics_segments.name: Returning Visitors
metrics_segments.description: Baseline segment isolating returning visitors via OOTB New/Return Visitor dimension. Supports BRD 704 returning-visitor banner reporting.

metrics_segments.name: Authenticated Users
metrics_segments.description: Baseline segment isolating visits where Login Status = authenticated (registered visitors).

metrics_segments.name: Registered Visitors
metrics_segments.description: Visitors who completed email registration verified via one-time code/link. Scopes registered-only reporting and RT-CDP counts.

metrics_segments.name: Unregistered Visitors
metrics_segments.description: Visitors who never registered, retaining full unrestricted content access. Supports registration-optional analysis.

metrics_segments.name: Registration Started Not Completed
metrics_segments.description: Visits that fired Registration Start but not Registration Complete. Drives registration funnel drop-off reporting.

metrics_segments.name: Registration Completed
metrics_segments.description: Visits that fired the Registration Complete event. Numerator for registration completion rate.

metrics_segments.name: Registration by Trigger Moment
metrics_segments.description: Segments registrations by the trigger moment eVar (QR prompt, itinerary adoption, profile) for funnel-by-trigger reporting.

metrics_segments.name: Tier 1 Festival Marketing Consent Granted
metrics_segments.description: Visitors who granted Tier 1 Festival Marketing consent. Supports consent tier distribution reporting.

metrics_segments.name: Tier 2 Year-Round NHB Consent Granted
metrics_segments.description: Visitors who granted Tier 2 Year-Round NHB consent. Supports consent tier distribution reporting.

metrics_segments.name: Functional Consent Only
metrics_segments.description: Visitors with Tier 0 Functional consent only and no marketing opt-ins. Isolates minimal-consent cohort.

metrics_segments.name: Consent Withdrawn
metrics_segments.description: Visitors who withdrew consent via self-service profile settings. Supports withdrawal rate reporting.

metrics_segments.name: Analytics Cookies Accepted
metrics_segments.description: Visitors who accepted Analytics & Performance cookies via the cookie consent banner. Scopes consented-analytics reporting.

metrics_segments.name: QR Checked-in Visitors
metrics_segments.description: Registered visitors with at least one confirmed QR check-in (installation ID + timestamp). Core venue engagement cohort.

metrics_segments.name: Unlocked Content Viewers
metrics_segments.description: Visits that viewed QR-unlocked content visible only to physically scanned-in visitors.

metrics_segments.name: Multi-Venue Check-in Visitors
metrics_segments.description: Visitors with QR check-ins at two or more distinct installations. Identifies high-engagement multi-venue explorers.

metrics_segments.name: Itinerary Creators
metrics_segments.description: Visitors who created a custom itinerary by adding programmes/installations.

metrics_segments.name: Trail Followers
metrics_segments.description: Registered visitors who saved and followed a trail with QR check-in progress tracking.

metrics_segments.name: Itinerary Sharers
metrics_segments.description: Visitors who shared an itinerary via native device share.

metrics_segments.name: Shared Itinerary Adopters
metrics_segments.description: Visitors who one-tap adopted a shared itinerary, triggering the light registration prompt. Supports Community Picks threshold analysis.

metrics_segments.name: Klook Ticketing CTA Clickers
metrics_segments.description: Visits that clicked the Klook ticketing call-to-action directing off-site. Measures off-site ticketing intent.

metrics_segments.name: Brand Concierge Users
metrics_segments.description: Visitors who interacted with Adobe Brand Concierge. Supports engagement, intent and escalation-rate reporting.

metrics_segments.name: Map Interaction Visits
metrics_segments.description: Visits with interaction on the interactive Bras Basah–Bugis precinct map.

metrics_segments.name: Location Permission Granted
metrics_segments.description: Visits where location permission was granted enabling proximity-based sorting (derived zone label, no raw GPS).

metrics_segments.name: Personalised Picks Engagers
metrics_segments.description: Registered visitors who engaged with the 'Your picks tonight' affinity-matched recommendation feed.

metrics_segments.name: Mobile Visitors
metrics_segments.description: Visits on mobile viewports via OOTB Device Type dimension. Supports mobile-first delivery and Core Web Vitals reporting.

events.description: Fires on Privacy Policy page view documenting PDPA data collection, purpose, retention and rights. Supports BRD 107.

events.name: Terms of Use View
events.description: Fires on Terms of Use page view. Supports BRD 108.

events.name: Cookie Policy View
events.description: Fires on Cookie Policy page view documenting all cookies, purpose, category and retention. Supports BRD 1812.

events.name: Registration Start
events.description: Journey Start event — fires when a visitor begins the email registration flow. Supports BRD 201/1205.

events.name: Registration Complete
events.description: Journey Complete event — fires when email registration is verified via one-time code or link. Supports BRD 201/202.

events.name: Registration Fail
events.description: Journey Fail event — fires when email verification fails or is abandoned during registration. Supports BRD 201/1205.

events.name: Consent Granted
events.description: Fires when a visitor grants a consent tier (Tier 0/1/2) via positive action at registration. Supports BRD 301/302/304.

events.name: Consent Withdrawn
events.description: Fires when a visitor withdraws consent via self-service profile settings, effective immediately. Supports BRD 303/304.

events.name: Cookie Consent Submitted
events.description: Fires when a visitor submits cookie consent choices via the banner or settings control. Supports BRD 1808/1809/1810/1811.

events.name: Data Rights Request
events.description: Fires on self-service view, correction or erasure of personal data requests. Supports BRD 1805.

events.name: Map Interaction
events.description: Fires on interaction with the Bras Basah–Bugis precinct map (pan, zoom, pin tap). Supports BRD 401/402.

events.name: Location Permission Granted
events.description: Fires when a visitor grants location permission, enabling proximity-based sorting by walking distance. Supports BRD 403.

events.name: Location Permission Denied
events.description: Fires when a visitor denies location permission; default listing behaviour applies without degradation. Supports BRD 404.

events.name: Crowd Density Indicator View
events.description: Fires when a live per-venue crowd density indicator is displayed, derived from real-time Adobe Analytics session data. Supports BRD 405/406.

events.name: Trail Saved
events.description: Fires when a registered visitor saves/follows a curated self-guided trail. Supports BRD 501/502.

events.name: Itinerary Item Added
events.description: Fires when a programme or installation is added to a custom itinerary. Supports BRD 503.

events.name: Itinerary Optimisation Suggestion
events.description: Fires when a dismissible non-blocking inline optimisation suggestion is surfaced for itinerary conflicts/inefficiencies. Supports BRD 504.

events.name: Itinerary Shared
events.description: Fires when an itinerary is shared via native device share (no social OAuth). Supports BRD 505/705.

events.name: Itinerary Adopted
events.description: Fires on one-tap adoption of a shared itinerary (triggers light registration prompt). Supports BRD 506/705.

events.name: Community Pick Surfaced
events.description: Fires when an itinerary reaching ≥10 unique festival-window adoptions is surfaced as a Community Pick. Supports BRD 507/705.

events.name: QR Check-in
events.description: Fires on a QR scan recorded as a confirmed check-in against the registered visitor's profile (installation ID + timestamp). Supports BRD 601/604/1803.

events.name: Unlocked Content View
events.description: Fires when unlocked content visible only to physically scanned-in visitors is loaded on the programme detail page. Supports BRD 602/605/1104.

events.name: Registration Prompt Shown
events.description: Fires when the dismissible email registration prompt is triggered on first QR scan by an unauthenticated visitor. Supports BRD 603/1205.

events.name: Picks Tonight Feed View
events.description: Fires when the 'Your picks tonight' affinity-matched bookmark feed is shown to a registered visitor. Supports BRD 702/706.

events.name: Trending With Circle Chip View
events.description: Fires when the 'Trending with your circle' chip is shown using session hash clustering. Supports BRD 703/706.

events.name: Returning Visitor Banner View
events.description: Fires when a contextual banner for unvisited bookmarks or incomplete trail stops is shown to a returning visitor. Supports BRD 704/706.

events.name: Programme Bookmarked
events.description: Fires when a visitor bookmarks a programme, feeding the 'Your picks tonight' and trending chip logic. Supports BRD 702/703.

events.name: Brand Concierge Interaction
events.description: Fires on a Brand Concierge query/interaction, capturing engagement for intent and engagement-rate reporting. Supports BRD 1405/1406.

events.name: Brand Concierge Escalation
events.description: Fires when a Brand Concierge interaction results in an escalation or unresolved/failed response, for failure-rate reporting. Supports BRD 1406.

segments.name: Production Data Only
segments.description: Restricts reporting to production environment hits where the Environment eVar = 'production'. Excludes dev/stage traffic.

segments.name: Bounce Rate
segments.description: OOTB calculated metric: single-hit visits divided by entries. Measures single-page visit share.

segments.name: Conversion Rate
segments.description: OOTB calculated metric: success events divided by visits. Baseline conversion measure.

segments.name: Pages per Visit
segments.description: OOTB calculated metric: page views divided by visits. Baseline depth-of-engagement measure.

segments.name: All Visits
segments.description: Baseline segment capturing all visits with no filter, used as a denominator and reporting default.

segments.name: New Visitors
segments.description: Baseline segment isolating first-time visitors via OOTB New/Return Visitor dimension.

segments.name: Returning Visitors
segments.description: Baseline segment isolating returning visitors via OOTB New/Return Visitor dimension. Supports BRD 704 returning-visitor banner reporting.

segments.name: Authenticated Users
segments.description: Baseline segment isolating visits where Login Status = authenticated (registered visitors).

segments.name: Registered Visitors
segments.description: Visitors who completed email registration verified via one-time code/link. Scopes registered-only reporting and RT-CDP counts.

segments.name: Unregistered Visitors
segments.description: Visitors who never registered, retaining full unrestricted content access. Supports registration-optional analysis.

segments.name: Registration Started Not Completed
segments.description: Visits that fired Registration Start but not Registration Complete. Drives registration funnel drop-off reporting.

segments.name: Registration Completed
segments.description: Visits that fired the Registration Complete event. Numerator for registration completion rate.

segments.name: Registration by Trigger Moment
segments.description: Segments registrations by the trigger moment eVar (QR prompt, itinerary adoption, profile) for funnel-by-trigger reporting.

segments.name: Tier 1 Festival Marketing Consent Granted
segments.description: Visitors who granted Tier 1 Festival Marketing consent. Supports consent tier distribution reporting.

segments.name: Tier 2 Year-Round NHB Consent Granted
segments.description: Visitors who granted Tier 2 Year-Round NHB consent. Supports consent tier distribution reporting.

segments.name: Functional Consent Only
segments.description: Visitors with Tier 0 Functional consent only and no marketing opt-ins. Isolates minimal-consent cohort.

segments.name: Consent Withdrawn
segments.description: Visitors who withdrew consent via self-service profile settings. Supports withdrawal rate reporting.

segments.name: Analytics Cookies Accepted
segments.description: Visitors who accepted Analytics & Performance cookies via the cookie consent banner. Scopes consented-analytics reporting.

segments.name: QR Checked-in Visitors
segments.description: Registered visitors with at least one confirmed QR check-in (installation ID + timestamp). Core venue engagement cohort.

segments.name: Unlocked Content Viewers
segments.description: Visits that viewed QR-unlocked content visible only to physically scanned-in visitors.

segments.name: Multi-Venue Check-in Visitors
segments.description: Visitors with QR check-ins at two or more distinct installations. Identifies high-engagement multi-venue explorers.

segments.name: Itinerary Creators
segments.description: Visitors who created a custom itinerary by adding programmes/installations.

segments.name: Trail Followers
segments.description: Registered visitors who saved and followed a trail with QR check-in progress tracking.

segments.name: Itinerary Sharers
segments.description: Visitors who shared an itinerary via native device share.

segments.name: Shared Itinerary Adopters
segments.description: Visitors who one-tap adopted a shared itinerary, triggering the light registration prompt. Supports Community Picks threshold analysis.

segments.name: Klook Ticketing CTA Clickers
segments.description: Visits that clicked the Klook ticketing call-to-action directing off-site. Measures off-site ticketing intent.

segments.name: Brand Concierge Users
segments.description: Visitors who interacted with Adobe Brand Concierge. Supports engagement, intent and escalation-rate reporting.

segments.name: Map Interaction Visits
segments.description: Visits with interaction on the interactive Bras Basah–Bugis precinct map.

segments.name: Location Permission Granted
segments.description: Visits where location permission was granted enabling proximity-based sorting (derived zone label, no raw GPS).

segments.name: Personalised Picks Engagers
segments.description: Registered visitors who engaged with the 'Your picks tonight' affinity-matched recommendation feed.

segments.name: Mobile Visitors
segments.description: Visits on mobile viewports via OOTB Device Type dimension. Supports mobile-first delivery and Core Web Vitals reporting.
